scope: Complete standalone application and real registered Audio Studio handlers in a test-local DOM/event adapter; canonical authoring, native-input isolation, canvas/native envelope synchronization and persistence contracts. Mock AudioContext sink only. Does not establish mobile keyboard activation, browser layout, trusted pointer behavior, audible output or hardware acceptance.
